Air India Group Plans Fleet Expansion Amid Transformation

The Air India Group is planning to add up to 60 new aircraft to its fleet over the next 18 months as part of a broader transformation program. This expansion comes as the airline works to restore its flight network, which was impacted by airspace closures and regional conflicts, leading to longer routes and increased operational costs. The move signals a significant step in the airline's efforts to improve its financial standing and operational efficiency.
